newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot propane mixed amid expected turnaround.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot propane mixed amid expected turnaround.

text.p: U.S. spot propane prices were steady to higher in quiet late trade on Tuesday amid news of scheduled maintenance at a large petrochemical company, traders said.
Dow Chemical said it plans to take down the larger of its two ethylene units in Plaquemine, Louisiana, for a 30-day scheduled turnaround beginning Oct. 14.
The unit, which also produces propylene, consumes between 50,000 to 60,000 barrels per day in feedstocks, such as ethane, naptha and propane.
The turnaround was expected by most traders.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane remained between 50.00 cents and 50.25 cents a gallon after retracing for the past two days.
Conway, Kansas, hub, which had been volatile much of the day, settled between 50.50/50.75 cents, helped up partially by stronger NYMEX crude oil futures, traders said.
Belvieu ethane stayed largely steady at 31.00/31.25, but Conway material edged up a quarter to 28.25/28.50 cents.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
